Package org.smtlib.logic

Class Logic

java.lang.Object
org.smtlib.impl.Pos.Posable
org.smtlib.impl.Pos.Printable
org.smtlib.impl.SMTExpr.Logic
org.smtlib.logic.Logic
All Implemented Interfaces:
ILanguage, ILogic, INode, IPos.IPosable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ALL, AUFLIA, AUFLIRA, AUFNIRA, DifferenceLogic, LIA, LRA, QF_AUFLIA, QF_AX, QF_BV, QF_EIA, QF_FP, QF_NIA, QF_NRA, QF_UF, QF_UFIDL, UFNIA
public abstract class Logic extends SMTExpr.Logic implements ILanguage
Common base for this package's per-logic syntactic-restriction classes (QF_IDL, LRA, QF_UF, etc). Each subclass overrides ILanguage.validExpression(org.smtlib.IExpr), ILanguage.checkFcnDeclaration(org.smtlib.IExpr.IIdentifier, java.util.List<org.smtlib.ISort>, org.smtlib.ISort, org.smtlib.IExpr), and ILanguage.checkSortDeclaration(org.smtlib.IExpr.IIdentifier, java.util.List<org.smtlib.ISort.IParameter>, org.smtlib.ISort) to reject whatever its own logic's SMT-LIB-mandated grammar forbids (quantifiers, uninterpreted functions, nonlinear arithmetic, unrestricted sorts, ...); this class supplies the shared helpers those overrides call (noQuantifiers, noFunctions, noSorts, checkArraySort, isLinearReal, ...).

Extends SMTExpr.Logic (the plain, unrestricted ILogic implementation sexpr.Parser falls back to when no subclass exists for a given logic name -- see issue #46) rather than depending only on the bare ILogic interface, so that a subclass which doesn't override one of the three hooks above still gets that hook's already-permissive default (an empty/no-op override) for free, instead of every subclass having to restate "permit everything" explicitly.

    • restrictionError

      protected IVisitor.VisitorException restrictionError(String message, IExpr e)
      Builds a VisitorException for a restriction violation (e.g. QF_IDL/QF_RDL's difference-logic shape, LRA's linearity check) whose message includes the offending expression's own printed text, not just an abstract description of the rule it broke -- several subclasses' checks used to throw the bare message alone, each with its own "// FIXME" noting the expression text was meant to be included but wasn't.

    • sortApp

      protected ISort sortApp(String name, ISort... params)
      Creates the sort expression name(params...), e.g. sortApp("Array", intSort, intSort) for (Array Int Int). Used to build canonical sorts for structural comparison (via ISort.equalsNoExpand(org.smtlib.ISort)), rather than comparing printed text.

    • allowedArraySorts

      protected String allowedArraySorts()
      The Array sorts this logic allows, as text for error messages, or null if it allows every Array sort. A logic restricting Array sorts overrides this and allowedArraySort(org.smtlib.ISort.IApplication).
